info.title: Kindtree Swap API
info.description: Headless API for Kindtree Swap (v1). Errors use application/problem+json with a catalog code.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The signed-in user's profile, location and public profiles.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Categories, items, drafts, publishing and ownership history.

tags.name: Test
tags.description: Test-only routes, registered only when NODE_ENV=test.

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is serving requests. Does not check dependencies.
Returns 200 only when the database and the private object-store bucket are reachable.
Returns the signed-in user. Creates the profile on first call. Coordinates are never returned.

patch.description: Updates the display name and bio. Onboarding completes once a display name and a location both exist.

put.description: Stores the point rounded to about 100 m. Only the coarse area label and the search radius are ever returned.

get.description: Returns 404 when either user has blocked the other.

post.description: Blocks another user. Blocks hide each user from the other in profiles, feeds and swaps.

get.description: Active categories with their attribute JSON Schema.
Items you own, newest first. Filter with status=draft,available,reserved,swapped,archived.
Your drafts, most recently edited first.

post.description: Creates a draft. Every field is optional. Drafts are limited to 50 per user.

get.description: Owners see every status. Others see only available items, and never when blocked.

patch.description: Partial update for the owner. Send If-Match with the version you last saw. A stale version returns 412 with the current item.

delete.description: Never-published drafts are removed with their media. Anything else is archived.

post.description: Requires title, category, condition, all required attributes, a ready image and an onboarded owner.
Not allowed while the item is reserved, swapped or archived.
Returns one presigned PUT URL per file. Send the bytes straight to the URL, then call complete.
Checks each upload is a real image of the declared type, then queues processing. Poll the item for status ready.

get.description: Oldest first. Each entry is an item in the chain, with its owner and creation time.
